findings.recital: processing a source document with a first extraction configuration to produce a first candidate representation comprising extracted text units, each unit bound
findings.unsupported_breadth: "each unit bound to a source evidence region" reads onto arbitrarily fine region granularity. Only page-level attribution is measured.
findings.why: The holdout records evidence at PAGE granularity — each row carries `image_path` and `document_id`, not a per-unit region. The claim recites a region per text unit. Unit-level binding exists in code and is exercised by unit tests; it was not the granularity measured over the 800-page holdout.

findings.recital: computing an **agreement signal** by comparing the first and second candidate representations at the granularity of the bound source evidence regions, rather th
findings.unsupported_breadth: "at the granularity of the bound source evidence regions" reads onto region-by-region comparison. Page-and-critical-token comparison is what was run.
findings.why: `cross_parser_mismatches` is recorded per page against a frozen operating point of 21 maximum critical-token mismatches, so the comparison is demonstrably NOT whole-document. It is page-and-token level rather than evidence-region level, so the negative half of the recital is measured and the positive half is measured one step coarser.

findings.recital: admitting to a downstream trusted store only representations classified accepted, and routing abstained representations to a recovery or review path without adm
findings.unsupported_breadth: "admitting to a downstream trusted store" reads onto a persistence and routing system that no A9 receipt exercises.
findings.why: The holdout computed acceptance states. It did not exercise admission to a downstream trusted store, and no receipt records a store admitting accepted representations and refusing abstained ones. The arbitration path exists in code with unit tests; that is implementation, not measurement.

findings.recital: The method of A1, wherein the abstention decision is recorded with the identities of the signals that were present, the signals that had no value, and the reaso
findings.unsupported_breadth: "the reason each absent signal had no value" reads onto a complete taxonomy of absence reasons. `MissingReason` enumerates the ones the implementation distinguishes, and no measurement establishes coverage.
findings.why: Openly drafted as an embodiment-supported dependent claim. No receipt records missing-reason discipline over real documents; the A9 holdout records `second_parser_available` but not a per-signal absence reason.

findings.recital: maintaining, for each derived knowledge unit, a **stable logical identifier** that persists across source-document revisions, together with a source evidence re
findings.unsupported_breadth: "stable" must not be read as always-continuing: identity is a judgement that can return unresolved, and 8 measured divergences fork lineage.
findings.why: Persistence across revisions is measured — H1-E2 measured 8 residual divergences, each a NEW/AMBIGUOUS classification flip, all path-dependent into the following revision. The *evidence region* half of this element is not separately measured by any B-family receipt; it is carried by §4.1 and the implementation.

findings.recital: classifying the difference between the prior and revised versions into typed change kinds comprising at least a **semantic** change kind, a **structural** chang
findings.unsupported_breadth: Reciting four kinds in one limitation lets the two measured on real data carry the two measured only on constructed data.
findings.why: The semantic and structural kinds are measured — `B-STRUCTURE-ONLY-STALE-DEFECT` is the reproduced failure that exists because the structural channel does. The temporal and authority kinds are exercised by `D-GOVERNANCE-LINEAGE-CONTROLLED` over 22 CONSTRUCTED cells, not over the real revision corpus, and the recital lists all four as one limitation.

findings.recital: maintaining a dependency graph whose edges are **typed by change kind**, such that a derived artifact declares which change kinds it is sensitive to;
findings.unsupported_breadth: "a derived artifact declares which change kinds it is sensitive to" reads onto artifact-authored declarations. What is measured is that traversal respects edge types.
findings.why: Typed traversal is measured through element 5, which is bound to `B-EQUIV-FRESH-HOLDOUT` and `B-STRUCTURE-ONLY-STALE-DEFECT`. What no receipt isolates is the *declaration* half — that an artifact declares its own sensitivity — as distinct from the graph carrying typed edges. The two are measured together and only their joint effect is observed.

findings.recital: The method of B1, wherein an incoming knowledge unit whose identity is **unresolved** does not contribute a changed logical identifier to element 5's traversal
findings.unsupported_breadth: A three-part negative limitation is satisfied only if all three hold. One cell does not establish all three over real revisions.
findings.why: Openly drafted as embodiment-supported and exercised by the `ambiguous` cell of the fresh-seed holdout, which is a single cell rather than a measured rate. Three distinct negative behaviours are recited — no seed, no modification, no removal — and no receipt reports them separately.

standing_bounds_control.what_it_does_not_prove: nothing about whether an attestation is true. Each is a written claim about the world, and condition 1 in particular rests on a command someone has to run -- the mechanism checks that it was asserted, not that it holds.
standing_bounds_control.what_it_proves: the classifier defaults to OPEN_ACTIONABLE, refuses a declaration missing any of the six attestations, and admits only a fully attested one

standing_bounds_note: A declared standing bound is a permanently unrepairable limitation. It is never deleted, never downgraded, never counted as fixed, and prints in every round. It does not block the stop rule; everything else does.
standing_prohibition: A pass whose control did not separate is NOT_RUN, never clean. Narrowing a pass, widening an exemption, or downgrading a finding after seeing it invalidates the round.
why_convergence_is_not_declared: The stop rule requires two consecutive clean rounds under this protocol, with every open actionable finding from the preceding round closed. Declared standing bounds remain outstanding and are printed rather than cleared. This tool reports rounds; it does not decide that a round was enough. Round 8 of a minimum of 2, with 0 consecutive clean.
